draft.subject: Getting Willow Works' first project going
draft.body:
Hi Hana,

Thanks for the questions this week -- Tariq covered both: a weekly summary email isn't available yet, but it's on the roadmap, and a cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing cycle, not immediately.

On setup, the piece that usually unlocks everything else is the first project: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and teammates can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Want me to walk through creating that first project with you on a short call this week?

Best,
Chidi
